description: tests/test_verify_release.py had no __main__ guard at all, so Bazel ran zero of its 13 tests. A new tests/test_every_test_class_runs_under_bazel.py now fails if any tests/test_*.py is ever missing a trailing __main__ guard, or has one that isn't its last statement.

evidence.delivered: Added the missing if __name__ == "__main__": unittest.main() block to tests/test_verify_release.py (was missing entirely, so Bazel ran 0/13 of its tests) and added tests/test_every_test_class_runs_under_bazel.py, an AST-based regression guard that fails if any tests/test_*.py file is ever missing a trailing __main__ guard, or has one that isn't its last statement.
evidence.deviations: This slice was originally implemented and reviewed earlier today as part of a larger PR (#53) whose branch had tangled pre-existing history (stacked on uncleaned copies of two other tasks' work). Two of that PR's three file changes (tests/test_gate.py, tests/test_task.py) turned out to be redundant with fixes independently merged via PR #48 and PR #52 in the meantime -- confirmed by diffing against origin/main before rebuilding. This slice was rebuilt from a clean base with only the genuinely unique, not-yet-merged content: the tests/test_verify_release.py fix and the new regression-guard test.
validation: ruff check + ruff format --check on both changed/new files -> clean

correctness.evidence:
VERIFICATION CHECKLIST:
1. test_verify_release.py has __main__ block at end: CONFIRMED (lines 195-196 are final lines)
2. AST logic flags missing guard: CONFIRMED (test shows False for missing guard)
3. AST logic flags guard not at end: CONFIRMED (test shows False when guard precedes other statements)
4. test_verify_release runs 13 tests: CONFIRMED (bazel test output: 'Ran 13 tests in 0.018s')
5. test_every_test_class_runs_under_bazel runs and passes: CONFIRMED (bazel test output: 'Ran 1 test in 0.070s' - PASSED)
6. All 32 tests in //tests/... pass: CONFIRMED (bazel test //tests/... reports: 'Executed 0 out of 32 tests: 32 tests pass')
7. No regressions detected: CONFIRMED (all test targets show PASSED status)
8. Diff matches specification: CONFIRMED (adds __main__ block to test_verify_release.py, adds new meta-test, updates CHANGELOG)

The fix correctly addresses the stated defect: test_verify_release.py was previously missing the `if __name__ == "__main__": unittest.main()` block, causing Bazel to run zero of its 13 tests (a vacuously green target). The fix adds the block at the file's end, enabling all 13 tests to execute under Bazel. The new regression guard (test_every_test_class_runs_under_bazel.py) prevents this class of bug from recurring silently.

findings.summary: The AST check validates the guard's structure (__name__ compared to __main__, unittest.main() called inside) but not the comparison operator itself, so a hypothetical `if __name__ != "__main__": unittest.main()` would pass. All 28 actual test files use == correctly and the check catches the two real defect shapes (missing guard, misplaced guard) this task exists to fix; low practical risk.

summary: Stop test classes below a __main__ block from being skipped under Bazel
